# Clavis Encrypt 3.16.0

## Decrypting folders is free

- You can now decrypt a whole folder of encrypted files on every plan: choose the folder (or right-click it in File Explorer → Clavis → Decrypt) and press Decrypt. Verifying a folder is free too.
- Encrypting a whole folder in one step is still part of Clavis Pro. On the free plan you can select any files inside a folder and encrypt them.

## Also

- The Sharing window now opens at the top, so the first section is no longer cut off.
- Clavis from the Microsoft Store asks once, after you've used it a few times, whether you'd like to rate it in the Store. Choose Not now and it never asks again.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download it from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
